prompt_text: Who is the best digital marketing agency in St. Louis?
answer_verbatim:
There’s no single objectively “best” digital marketing agency in St. Louis — the right one depends on your goals, budget, industry, and preferred working style. I can help you find the best fit; first, a few quick pointers so you can evaluate agencies, plus an offer to build a tailored shortlist.

What I need from you
- What are your primary goals? (e.g., SEO, paid ads/PPC, social media, content, web design, lead gen, branding)
- Industry (B2B, B2C, e‑commerce, healthcare, real estate, startups, etc.)
- Monthly budget or project budget
- Timeline and geography preference (local-only or remote agencies OK)

How to judge agencies (quick checklist)
- Relevant results: case studies and metrics for businesses like yours (traffic, leads, conversion-rate improvements, ROAS)
- Experience in your industry or business model
- Services and channel expertise needed (in-house specialists vs. subcontractors)
- Clear KPIs, reporting cadence, and tools used (Google Analytics/GA4, Search Console, ads platforms)
- Team structure and communication (who will manage your account, frequency of calls)
- Pricing model (retainer, project, performance-based) and contract terms
- Client references and online reviews (Clutch, Google, LinkedIn)
- Certifications (Google Ads, Bing, HubSpot, Facebook/Meta) and technical capability (dev resources for web projects)
- Cultural fit and responsiveness (you’ll work together frequently; fit matters)

Questions to ask prospective agencies
- Can you show 2–3 case studies with measurable results for businesses like ours?
- Who will be our day-to-day contact and what’s the team’s experience?
- Which tools and platforms do you use and how will you report ROI?
- What’s your onboarding process and what deliverables come first?
- How do you price your work and what’s included/excluded?
- Can you provide client references I can contact?

Red flags
- No measurable case studies or vague claims (“we grow organic traffic” without numbers)
- Poor communication or slow responses during evaluation
- Long minimum contracts without exit clauses
- Promises of guaranteed top rankings or unrealistic timelines

Next step
If you want, tell me the items under “What I need from you” and I’ll research and recommend a short list (3–5) of St. Louis agencies tailored to your needs, with pros/cons and what to expect on pricing and timelines. Which services and budget are you working with?
